device.modelDescription: actions that return a Buffer, a typed array or a DataView where JSON belongs, beside clean and badly encoded base64

actionList.name: returnsBuffer
actionList.description: Returns a Buffer in a field declared base64, instead of its base64 string.

actionList.name: returnsNestedView
actionList.description: Returns a Uint8Array inside an array item.

actionList.name: returnsUntypedView
actionList.description: Returns a DataView in a field its schema leaves untyped.

actionList.name: returnsBase64
actionList.description: Returns canonical base64 in a field declared base64: the control case.

actionList.name: returnsBadBase64
actionList.description: Returns base64 with a pad bit set in a field declared base64.
